name: What are common causes for the sound of running water when everything is off?

mainEntity.name: What are common causes for the sound of running water when everything is off?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several issues can cause the sound of running water when all taps are off. A continuously running or intermittently filling toilet is a frequent cause. Other possibilities include a leak in an irrigation system, a hot water heater continuously refilling due to a pressure relief valve issue, or a more serious hidden pipe leak within walls, floors, or under the slab. Even a small drip can produce a noticeable sound over time, indicating a larger problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common causes include running toilets, irrigation leaks, hot water heater issues, or hidden pipe leaks within walls or under the slab.
